T27 cell: 27 seats in 3 trits against FP4's 16 codes in 4 bits

Drag a weight along one line and see where a 27-level T27 cell and a 4-bit E2M1 code round it, and what 32 weights cost in trits and in bits. Numbers from two compiled .t27 specs.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • trinity-fpga specs/numeric/ternary_storage_search.t27 at 1f68b921a: T27_N, E2M1, E2M2 level tables, the cell and dense-packing counts
  • trinity-fpga specs/numeric/ternary_storage_search_v2.t27 at 49a84ade5 (sha256 88fcf517...0d4d): TRITS_* and BITS_* per 32 weights, the NVFP4 per-tensor scale
  • trinity-fpga research/block/ternary_storage_search_v2.json at d31d8523c: test perplexity of every arm, SmolLM2-135M, wikitext-2, 40 windows
  • trinity-fpga research/block/TERNARY_STORAGE_V2_VERDICT_2026-09-27.md at d31d8523c: the limits stated on this page
  • public/t27/t27_compiler.wasm: compiles both specs and runs their test blocks; python statistics.NormalDist recomputes T27_N
  • scripts/widget-data/t27-cell.mjs writes data.json; scripts/widget-data/t27-cell-card.py draws card.png from it
